en: Salutations to you, the Blessed One, the Great-Souled Śaṅkara, the cause of the creation and destruction of the universe, and the cause of liberation. ||1||
Salutations to the supreme god of all gods, the lord of Pārvatī; you alone are the ultimate refuge for the sages, yogis, and lords of seers. 2.
O Lord, in this cosmic egg, you are the foremost among the compassionate; therefore, you drank the most virulent hālāhala poison.
O Gaṅgādhara Mahādeva, whose head is adorned by the moon; O Supreme Lord, protect me! Ward off [my] fear, ward it off! 4.
Quell all evil, ward off all suffering; remove every misery without exception, and swiftly drive away death. (5)
I have no power to offer praise to you, who are beyond the reach of the path of speech; O Śaṅkara, grant me the company of the virtuous and unwavering devotion to you.
Avert all misfortune, destroy all enemies; O Lord of All, remove poverty and fulfill all desires. (7)
May your name be in my mouth, your form in my eyes, and your lotus feet in my heart; salutations to you, O Sāmba, be forever gracious unto me. (8)
I know not the ritual for your worship, nor does devotion dwell within my heart; nevertheless, O Lord, out of mere compassion, please grant me your grace and deliver me. 9.
Thus ends the Śaṅkarastotra composed by the venerable Paramahaṃsa Parivrājakācārya Śrī Vāsudevānanda Sarasvatī.
